_description: Data-derived symbolic rule base for Level 5 (v2). Rules extracted from predicate-intent chi2 association mining on level5_labeled.csv. Contrast with rule_base.json (hand-authored by domain expert). See level5/model/rule_miner.py for the full derivation procedure.
_changes_from_v1: DR1 replaces R1: adds is_infrastructure (lift=1.56, P=0.396 for investigate) instead of is_known_incident (P=0.087); wraps with is_sre_domain
DR2 = R2 (data-validated): has_runbook chi2=928.6, lift=3.80 for execution
DR3 is NEW — no human-authored equivalent: is_infrastructure+is_sre_domain+NOT has_runbook → execution; fills coverage gap for ad-hoc infra ops

DR4 v2: removed is_metric from antecedent (aligns with L4 TYPE-F constraint: summarization+metric = temporal phase mismatch); keeps is_incident only (lift=3.82). Metric queries are handled by DR1 (investigate).

rules.name: DR1_sre_infra_or_metric_investigate
rules.description: SRE-domain utterances about infrastructure or metric queries are investigation requests

_support.rationale: is_infrastructure (P=0.396, lift=1.56) is 4.5× more common in investigate than is_known_incident (P=0.087 in human R1). is_metric_query (lift=2.22) is the highest-lift investigate signal. AND with is_sre_domain reduces false positives from non-SRE mentions.

rules.name: DR2_runbook_execution
rules.description: SRE utterances with runbook/procedural actions are execution requests

_support.rationale: has_runbook is the single strongest signal in the dataset (chi2=928.6, lift=3.80, P=0.676 for execution). Human R2 is fully data-validated — rule and antecedents unchanged.

rules.name: DR3_infra_execution_no_runbook
rules.description: Infrastructure entity in SRE domain without a runbook and with known entity type → direct (ad-hoc) execution

_support.rationale: is_infrastructure has lift=1.72 for execution (chi2=95.3, P=0.436). NOT is_unknown guard added (v2 fix): prevents unsafe execution when entity type is uncertain (was causing TYPE-D violations). For legitimate infra entities is_unknown≈0 so (1-is_unknown)≈1 — no activation loss for clean cases.

rules.name: DR4_incident_summarization
rules.description: SRE incidents without a runbook → summarization/status report. is_metric removed: aligns with L4 TYPE-F constraint (summarization+metric = temporal phase mismatch). Metric queries handled by DR1 (investigate).

_support.rationale: is_incident has the highest lift for summarization (3.82). is_metric (lift=2.03) was removed in v2 to comply with L4 safety ontology: summarization+metric is a TYPE-F temporal phase mismatch (metrics are real-time; summarization implies historical reporting). Metric queries are correctly routed by DR1 to investigate instead.

rules.name: DR5_unknown_out_of_scope
rules.description: Unknown entity with no SRE domain context → out_of_scope

_support.rationale: is_unknown is the dominant out_of_scope signal (chi2=1135.6, P=1.0 — every OOS row in the dataset has is_unknown=1). Human R4 is fully data-validated — rule and antecedents unchanged.
